items.raw_excerpt: When we think about Portugal's real estate needs, the first answer is almost always the same: we need to build more houses, hotels, student residences, spaces for companies and new infrastructure. In many segments, this is indisputably true; but there is a second question we rarely ask: are we using the buildings we already have well?

items.title_en: Portugal looks to reuse old buildings as economic assets
